desc: Sometimes, you just don't know what's around the next turn or over the horizon so all you can do is prepare for the worst. The Contingency Duffel 85L enables you to carry a full kit properly organized in a load of pockets and compartments that will enable you to access what you need, when you need it. Capable of pack, sling and hand carry options, its low visibility silhouette will make even the greyest grey man feel at home in any scenario.
